text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The day of the Kikuka Sho, the final 
destination of the Classic Triple Crown, 
has arrived—

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
"Man, Mejiro Ardan's in, but I still think 
Yaeno Muteki has the upper hand this time, 
don't you?"

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Even her older sister Mejiro Ramonu has 
never run 3000m, right? It might be tough 
for her~.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
(What on earth is this presence...? I've 
never felt such pressure before——)

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: —It seems you can feel it as well.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Yaeno-san—

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
"The bizarre aura drifting through this 
place. At first, I thought it was 
Ardan-san, but—"

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: It seems to be her.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Her...?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: ――Ardan-chan, Yaeno-chan.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
It's an honor to run alongside you today~♪ 
I'll be giving it everything I've got, so—

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Please, I'll be counting on you.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Yes, likewise—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
(Super Creek-san. Gentle and kindhearted, 
with an embracing warmth like a mother to 
everyone.)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: (Even so, the her of today is—)

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Well then, I'll be taking my leave now~

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: …………Like a completely different person.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
(Behind that smile, I can feel a fierce 
determination ready to swallow up 
everything present here today—)

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: —That is wonderful news.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
If more formidable competitors gather, 
then so much the better.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
"Because the fiercer the battle becomes, 
the further we can push past our limits."

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: ...That is what you're thinking, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Do you understand?

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
I may not compare to Chiyono O-san, but I 
still consider myself a good friend of 
yours.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: ...It's written all over your face.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Fufu. ...I'm truly embarrassed.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: ――Well then. I shall take my leave first.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
(...This race, too, will surely become an 
irreplaceable "now.")

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Let us go, myself included. To the final 
destination of the Triple Crown—
